replies.What is your relationship with mathemati: Mathematics feels like a mix of fascination and frustration. I appreciate the logic, especially in physics, but the abstract nature of it often overwhelms me. My parents had vastly different educational backgrounds, so my own approach is independent. I prefer visualizing concepts through photography rather than solving equations. It's a tool, not a passion.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Absolutely. Anxiety spikes when formulas become abstract or complex. My high neuroticism score makes me prone to worry about performance or understanding. I often avoid math when stressed, preferring to go for a walk or watch birds. It's a mental block that I try to manage by stepping away from the numbers.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Not really. I haven't used AI for math learning specifically. I tend to avoid new tech tools that require steep learning curves, especially ones tied to subjects I dislike. My focus is on practical, established methods rather than experimenting with AI. I find the technology distracting and unnecessary for my needs.
